PREVIEW_UI_SETTINGS.ACCESS_CONTROL.title: Access Control
PREVIEW_UI_SETTINGS.ANONYMOUS.descriptio: Allow anonymous (non-authenticated) users to access the Astrum One UI.
PREVIEW_UI_SETTINGS.ANONYMOUS.label: Anonymous Users
PREVIEW_UI_SETTINGS.DISPOSAL.DISABLE_LEG: Completely remove access to the Classic UI (ExtJS). The Astrum One UI becomes the only available interface, and the header toggle to switch back is removed.

CAUTION: When enabled, all users lose access to the Classic UI immediately. If users encounter bugs or missing features in the Astrum One UI, they will have no fallback until an administrator disables this setting.
PREVIEW_UI_SETTINGS.DISPOSAL.title: Disable Classic UI
PREVIEW_UI_SETTINGS.INFO.reloadNote: Changes to these settings take effect after the page reloads.
PREVIEW_UI_SETTINGS.LOGGEDIN.description: Allow authenticated users to access the Astrum One UI.
PREVIEW_UI_SETTINGS.LOGGEDIN.label: Logged-in Users
PREVIEW_UI_SETTINGS.MENU.description: Configure access to the Astrum One UI experience
PREVIEW_UI_SETTINGS.ROLLOUT.DEFAULT_TO_P: When enabled, all users land on the Astrum One UI after login. Users can still switch back to the Classic UI at any time using the toggle in the page header.
PREVIEW_UI_SETTINGS.ROLLOUT.DISABLE_SWIT: Hide the feedback prompt and prevent Astrum One UI from sending feedback when users switch back to Classic UI.
PREVIEW_UI_SETTINGS.ROLLOUT.title: Rollout Control
PREVIEW_UI_SETTINGS.description: Control access to the Astrum One UI experience. The Astrum One UI provides a modern, redesigned interface with improved usability and new features.
PREVIEW_UI_SETTINGS.title: Astrum One UI Settings

UPGRADE_ALERT.PENDING.OLDER_LABEL: Astrum Repository versioning is out of date.
UPGRADE_ALERT.PENDING.TEXT: New features and functionality will not be available until the upgrade process is complete.
UPGRADE_ALERT.PENDING.TEXT_18_MONTHS: You are currently running a sunsetted GlobalArt Astrum Repository version. UPGRADE_ALERT.PROGRESS.LABEL: Upgrade in progress
UPGRADE_ALERT.WARN.LABEL: Mixed Mode detected.
UPGRADE_ALERT.WARN.TEXT: Astrum Repository detected that 1 or more node(s) are running different Astrum Repository versions. This is not supported except briefly during the upgrade process. Remaining in mixed mode outside of an active upgrade process can result in unexpected behavior and Astrum Repository becoming unstable. Ensure all nodes are on the same version as soon as possible.
